::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept. 27 1864  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55383 (1): P. 385
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	

There are three aspects of [*illegible*]  [Miss Bonham Carter](people/person_1913.qmd), not [*illegible*] is the artist. [I](people/person_939.qmd) saw it in his studio and concluded it was his own. Of course we can only [engrave](organizations/other_167.qmd) one of the three. I think unquestionably the one looking to the right.[^1]

Please tell me how you like it

Yours ever truly
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: Probably portraits of  Florence Nightingale that Macmillan was proposing for the title page vignette in *A Book of Golden Deeds*. The Bonham-Carters were [Florence Nightingale](people/person_1086.qmd)’s cousins
